checkpoint.title: Saffron Gym: Sabrina and the MARSHBADGE

events.why: the precondition for Sabrina: the lead at least Lv46, pokeguy's Blastoise here (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, sabrina: from 33/143 HP, 98.3% of the sims win, 90.1% to 100.0%); at his level or above, those sims stand for this fight and no new one is needed; below it, the run stops here, before the fight

Sabrina (TRAINER_LEADER_SABRINA): Kadabra Lv38, Mr. Mime Lv37, Venomoth Lv38, Alakazam Lv43 (pokeguy: Water Pulse, Surf, Bite and Blizzard, 1:33:30 to 1:34:38); then the MARSHBADGE and TM04 Calm Mind. Fought by pokeguy's C2 (PokemonSimulation docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, sabrina: goal-based-setup with no Sp. Atk goal, X Speed to outspeed Alakazam, Guard Spec first; 98.3% of the doc's sims from 33/143 HP); foe_threats are planning_risk() for each foe leading against the doc's entry (Blastoise Lv46)

checkpoint: Sabrina (14, 11), talked to from below, from the save in front of her (18.01): Kadabra Lv38, Mr. Mime Lv37, Venomoth Lv38, Alakazam Lv43 (sParty_LeaderSabrina); then the MARSHBADGE and TM04 Calm Mind. PokeGuy has Blastoise at Lv46 here (pokeguy-route.md, section 14).
A boss battle is its own checkpoint (user, 2026-11-12): it ends in front of her after the MARSHBADGE and TM04 text, and saves there; 18.02b goes on out of the gym.
